corrections.text: The article quotes Healthline as saying the United States "is at risk of losing its measles elimination status, which it has held for the past quarter-century." This exact sentence does not appear in the source. Healthline actually contains two separate sentences — a summary line reading "The United States is at risk of losing its measles elimination status, which it has held since 2000," and a body sentence reading "The United States is poised to lose its measles exemption status, which it has held for the past quarter-century." The article's quotation combines clauses from both. The underlying fact (the US elimination status, held since 2000, is at risk) is accurate and supported by the source.
